title: Discovery of a Potent and Selective First-In-Class Antagonist of GPR15 With In Vivo Anti-Obesity Activity.
authors: Huang, Chong; Qiao, Jingxin; Zhou, Mengqiu; Yang, Xin; Zhu, Lengjing; Ru, Jinxiao; Du, Le; Liu, Wuxin; Chen, Yan; Xia, Anjie; Li, Linli; Yang, Shengyong
one_liner_zh: 该文发现首个GPR15小分子拮抗剂，结合分子对接、MD模拟和AI结构预测阐明结合模式，虽以药物发现为主，但蛋白质结构计算建模（对接/MD/AI预测）方法对蛋白结构计算课题有参考价值。
abstract: GPR15 (G Protein-coupled Receptor 15), an atypical chemokine receptor, is implicated in the pathogenesis of multiple diseases, yet small-molecule GPR15 antagonists remain undeveloped. Herein, we identify and characterize YL410, the first-in-class potent and selective GPR15 antagonist. In the cAMP-GloSensor assay, YL410 inhibits GPR15 with an IC(50) of 0.027 +/- 0.005 microM, and displays high selectivity against a panel of related GPCRs and kinases. It suppresses GPR15L-induced Jurkat T-cell migration, and exhibits favorable pharmacokinetics and acceptable safety. Molecular docking, replicated molecular dynamics simulations, quantitative contact analyses, and mutagenesis experiments support a plausible orthosteric binding model for YL410, maintained by a reproducible network of polar and hydrophobic contacts, which rationalizes its potent antagonism and observed structure-activity relationships (SAR). Complementary AI-based structure predictions (AlphaFold3, Chai-1, and Boltz) recapitulated the energetically accessible orthosteric poses but not the dynamically stable pose selected by the MD simulations, underscoring the importance of kinetic-stability validation in antagonist pose selection. Notably, in a diet-induced obesity (DIO) mouse model, YL410 administration induced significant weight loss and exerted blood glucose-lowering effects. Collectively, this study presents the first potent, selective, and in vivo efficacious GPR15 antagonist, providing new insights into the development of therapeutics for the treatment of obesity.
abstract_zh: GPR15（G蛋白偶联受体15）是一种非典型趋化因子受体，与多种疾病的发病机制相关，然而小分子GPR15拮抗剂尚未开发。在此，我们识别并表征了YL410，这是首个强效且选择性的GPR15拮抗剂。在cAMP-GloSensor实验中，YL410以IC(50)为0.027 ± 0.005微M抑制GPR15，并对一系列相关GPCR和激酶表现出高选择性。它抑制GPR15L诱导的Jurkat T细胞迁移，并展现出良好的药代动力学特性和可接受的安全性。分子对接、重复分子动力学模拟、定量接触分析和突变实验支持YL410的合理正构位点结合模型，该模型由可重复的极性和疏水接触网络维持，从而解释了其强效拮抗作用及观察到的构效关系（SAR）。基于AI的互补结构预测（AlphaFold3、Chai-1和Boltz）重现了能量可及的正构位姿，但未重现MD模拟选择的动态稳定位姿，这强调了在拮抗剂位姿选择中动力学稳定性验证的重要性。值得注意的是，在饮食诱导肥胖（DIO）小鼠模型中，YL410给药诱导显著体重减轻并发挥降血糖作用。总体而言，本研究提供了首个强效、选择性且体内有效的GPR15拮抗剂，为肥胖治疗药物的开发提供了新见解。
